lines.name: Harbour Line
lines.beyond: north on Harbour Road past Crown Road (y 320); south on Sunset Way past Comet Row (y -780); termini and depot off-sheet

notes: Kept: S1 trunk and skyport loop, unchanged. Over public space only: Circus Road, the circus island, the Parade mall, Harbour Road, quay, water. T1 is also unchanged: double trunk on the Boulevard and an R25/R28 balloon loop on the circus island. The plan says T1 ends at the circus; tide's draft says it runs through. That is the open question in the plan notes, so I left it for Sky. Running on is possible: straight over the island, a 6.5 m S-curve on Crown Avenue, then R50 west onto Crown Road to x -400.

Not proposed: tide's two-way Sky Loop. The plan concept chose one straight trunk, and whether to retire the loops is an open question for Sky. Geometry: an R70 fillet at a ring corner swings about 29 m inside the vertex. The kerb corner of two 24 m roads is only about 17 m in. So the beam would pass over corner plots (S-C1) unless pushed outward over undefined ground.

Added T2 Harbour Line, a change to tide's draft. Harbour Road has no street south of Comet Row, and no street space anywhere fits a balloon loop (needs R25 or more). So the line cannot end inside the sheet (T-L1). Instead it runs from the north edge down Harbour Road, west along Market Street over T1 at grade, then down Sunset Way to the south edge. Both ends leave the sheet, so N-D1 and T-L1 pass with no loop.

T-C1 corners, hand-computed, not yet run through the checker. The tracks sit off the road centreline so the R50 arcs clear the kerb corners. Harbour/Market: centre (256.5,-366.5), kerb corner 46.7 m away, inner track r 48.2. Market/Sunset: centre (-298,-453.5), kerb corner 45.7 m away. On Market Street an R50 S-curve between x -140 and -200 crosses the 6 m median. Every track stays within the kerbs.

Interchange room for N-C1, stops for Vantage to place. T2 meets T1 where Market Street crosses the Boulevard at (0,-416.5), 36 m from T1's Records stop. It meets S1 where Harbour Road crosses at (306.5,0), 33.5 m from Harbour station. Both are within the 150 m interchange limit.
Conflict for Aster: the plan concept names Crown Circus as 'the one interchange'. With T2 there are two more, at Records/Market and at Harbour. The concept note needs updating if Sky accepts T2.

Handoffs. Waymark: T2 runs along Market Street past both Records Precinct gates (Rocket Lane, Satellite Street), so a T2 stop there becomes a station for police to seal. Pulse: T1 and T2 cross on the level (diamond) at the Boulevard and Market Street. Keel to review.
